class: In a long-running loop that serves many items (strategies, users, jobs), any exception raised OUTSIDE the per-item try (re-reading the item list, reading a setting, the outer run loop) ends the whole process, so one bad item or one database blip stops the work for every item, and nothing restarts it.
mechanism: GC-MU step 4 (98b54260): Worker.cycle called rebuild() and background_seconds() before the per-strategy try; run() had no try; owner_lister caught only TrackedExited/TrackedUnreadable per strategy.

first_seen.where: GC-MU step 4, Tier A read-only review (MAJOR, REQ-115 AC-9)
first_seen.evidence: background.py:326-352 read; no test made the list reader fail

fix: ba123221: per-strategy try in owner_lister; a failed re-read keeps the last good list; a failed speed read keeps the last good speed; run() catches Exception per cycle (CancelledError passes); a check that raises sets PAUSED.

checks: tests_app/test_background_cycle.py (failing list re-read, speed read, run loop, owner_lister per-strategy, PAUSED on failure; one mutant per guard)
